_note: Player news for the News page, supplied by the user. One entry per item. date: YYYY-MM-DD. type: signing, transfer, departure, injury, return, retirement, national or other. name: the player as the item writes him; pid: his id in this database (the number in his profile link, #/p/<pid>) - leave it out and the build looks the name up. to / from: the teams, as the site spells them. league: for a club outside Malaysia. text: the item itself. note: an optional second line. A signing or transfer makes 'to' the player's newest team on his card and profile until the database has later games for him. mark: the league's logo key in data/complogos (optional). spotlight: 'next-mbl-game' opens Home with this item's hero card (in place of the MBL milestone card) until the next MBL game tips off.
